title: Lear and Jim Goodall camp out at Area 51 in the '70s

tellings.quote: John Lear and his good friend and aviation photographer and journalist named Jim Goodall are camping out of Area 51 and Groom Lake constantly.

plain: A podcast host, Jesse Michels, says that in the 1970s a man named John Lear and his good friend Jim Goodall, an aviation photographer and journalist, were constantly camping out near Area 51, a secret military base in Nevada built beside a dry lake called Groom Lake. He tells it as part of the story of people watching the base for signs of secret aircraft long before it became famous.
